title: The Lost Colt
lines: A wild colt got lost in the cold.
A kind child and Mom went to find it.
The child held a rope and a lamp.
The colt was behind an old post.
It was cold and it did not move.
The child told it to hold still.
The child was bold and held the rope.
The colt is home and it is not cold.

questions.listenFor: Behind an old post. Stated in the story - have them go back and find it themselves.

questions.ask: What did the child bring along?
questions.listenFor: A rope and a lamp. If they get one, ask "what else?" rather than filling it in for them.

questions.ask: Do you think the child was brave? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason tied to the story - going out in the cold with Mom, or holding a wild colt.
